transcript: I have six days to deep clean this entire flat. And if I don't, the elderly woman who lives here will be evicted and lose her home. Her entire flat has become hoarded and infested with mice. They've chewed through almost everything, including the mattress that she'd been sleeping on. Her kitchen was no longer usable, so she created this makeshift one instead in the corner of the bedroom. And if anyone was wondering, no, her family had absolutely no idea she was living like this. Like many people struggling with their mental health, this resident had become very good at hiding just how bad things had gotten. By the time her family found out, the council had already issued an eviction notice. And that's when they contacted me, which means that this has very quickly become an emergency free clean. And I'm not just cleaning this bedroom, I have to do the entire flat. So I'm going to stop yapping and start cleaning. Because we're going to have to speed run a few things. The carpet needs ripping out, the walls need repainting, and obviously the mouse infestation needs to be dealt with. But there is some really good news. If I can get this property cleaned, cleared, and safe enough for the council to properly access it, they've said that they're willing to help with the repairs and the infestation. Meaning the elderly woman who lives here will be able to move back in and keep her home. So the pressure is on. We have six days, and judging by this bedroom alone, we're going to need every single minute of them. And if you're still watching, this butt shakes for you. Every time you watch and interact with my videos, you are directly funding the next free clean for someone who needs it. Because of you, for the first time in years, this elderly resident now has a bed. And yes, we still need to get flooring and all of the walls repainted, and we need to deal with the mice infestation. But like I said before, that is being done. If you want to see the rest of this home transformation, drop me a follow, and I'll see you in the next one. I love ya!
